purpose: Technical evaluation of text-free masked removal; no product capability or distribution approval
reference: Apple Silicon, at least 16 GiB, macOS 14 or newer
inputMapping: native pixels, centered integer translation; identical edge-clamp sampler for RGB and binary mask in artificial context padding; no scaling; padding is cropped away
modelAlpha: straight unassociated RGB; hold original source alpha separately and restore it before final compositor; no pre-matting
modelMask: Gray8 >=128 replaces, including clamped masked edge samples in artificial padding; original native soft mask retained for final compositor
quality: Object disappears without a new object, visible seam, texture discontinuity or halo; original zero-mask RGBA remains byte-identical after the current product compositor
releaseConditions: A technical pass alone is insufficient: complete source/conversion/weight-license provenance, actual product-adapter tests, cancellation and interactive-preview measurements are required before a new capability Go. Background prompts and outpainting are not removal capabilities.
